          (∀ (w : BfgsVerification.LBlockSplitting.Coordinates), E w 4 = w.1 1) ∧
            (∀ (w : BfgsVerification.LBlockSplitting.Coordinates),
                (fderiv ℝ (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ) BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed)
                    (E w) =
                  E

                      (BfgsVerification.LBlockSplitting.diagonalMap
                          ![BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.seedRatio⁻¹, BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.seedRatio⁻¹, lu])
                        w.2)) ∧
              (↑(fderiv ℝ (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.returnMap μ)
                      BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.seed)).charpoly =
                (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.seedRatio⁻¹) ^ 2 *
                      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ls) *
                    (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C lu) *
                  (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C BfgsVerification.SeedOrbit.seedRatio)
